```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

cv_raw <- read_csv('./scouting2026/computer_vision_scouting/robocv.csv')

comp_raw <- read_csv('./scouting2026/shinyapp/data/vaale/data.csv')

# 0 unkown
# 1 top left : blue close
# 2 middle left : blue middle
# 3 bottom left : blue far
# 4 top right : red close
# 5 middle right : red middle
# 6 bottom right : red far

blue_alliance = c("B1", "B2", "B3")
red_alliance = c("R1", "R2", "R3")
    
comp_data <- comp_raw |>
    mutate(robot = case_when(
        robot %in% blue_alliance & start_pos == "C" ~ 1,
        robot %in% blue_alliance & start_pos == "M" ~ 2, 
        robot %in% blue_alliance & start_pos == "F" ~ 3, 
        robot %in% red_alliance & start_pos == "C" ~ 4, 
        robot %in% red_alliance & start_pos == "M" ~ 5, 
        robot %in% red_alliance & start_pos == "F" ~ 6
    ))

combined <- comp_data |>
    left_join(cv_raw, by = c("match", "robot"))

view(combined)



```
